class.name: CbMove
class.brief_description: How the player moves while what an item does is on.
class.description: Movement parameters for a while, in what using an item does (the nodes under a [CbItem]). Under a [CbProbe] or a [CbLink], while that holds (hanging on a line: gravity 0). Directly under the item, for [member duration] seconds from the use (a dash's slide: friction 0). They win over the server's, the character's and a server mod's for that long. Under a [CbMotion], use its own parameters instead.

members.member: Directly under the item: how long it lasts from the use, in seconds. Under a probe or a link: not read (it lasts while that holds).
Movement parameters by name ([code]friction[/code] = 0, [code]gravity[/code] = 0, [code]air_control[/code] = 0.6): see the server mods' movement parameters.
